evals.prompt: The sales widget in SalesDashboard/SalesDashboard/Presentation/SalesDashboardWidget.xaml only handles the happy path where data is present. Add loading, empty, and error states to it — it should still look like the same widget in every state.
evals.expected_output: SalesDashboardWidget gains Loading (skeleton mirroring the populated layout), Empty (neutral message, CTA only if supported), and Error (message + Retry wired to an existing command) states. Shell, padding, corner radius, typography, and resource usage are unchanged; existing bindings still work; project builds.
assertions: The populated/data path's existing bindings and markup are preserved (not rewritten or restyled)
Loading state uses a skeleton that mirrors the populated row/column structure, not a lone centered spinner
Empty and Error states are visually distinct: Empty uses neutral emphasis, Error uses the app's semantic error resource as accent only
No new hardcoded colors, corner radii, or spacing values where an existing app resource exists
All states live inside the same component shell (FeedView templates, VisualStateManager, or state-bound visibility) rather than three duplicated components

evals.expected_output: Only Loading and Empty states are generated for the dashboard's data regions; no Error state is added. The page's visual identity (tokens, typography, density) is untouched.
assertions: Only loading and empty states are produced; no error state is added
Skeleton placeholders approximate the real content's footprint to minimize layout shift
Existing StaticResource/ThemeResource tokens are reused instead of literal values

evals.prompt: QuoteCraft's dashboard (QuoteCraft/src/QuoteCraft/Presentation/DashboardPage.xaml) looks broken when the quote list is empty or a fetch fails. Can you make it handle those situations gracefully, plus a skeleton while it loads?
evals.expected_output: Since QuoteCraft already uses Uno Toolkit FeedView, states are expressed through FeedView's ProgressTemplate/NoneTemplate/ErrorTemplate (or the app's established pattern) rather than a new state architecture. Empty state offers a CTA only if a create-quote flow exists; Error offers Retry wired to the existing refresh.
assertions: The implementation follows the app's existing state mechanism (FeedView templates) instead of introducing a new architecture
Empty state CTA, if present, is wired to an existing command rather than a dead button
No raw exception text is shown in the error state
